title: Data Creative Menu
description: Makes it so that custom items from datapacks show up in the creative menu.
body:
This mod makes every custom CRAFTABLE item show up in the creative menu.

Builtin support for [The Bracken Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/the-bracken-pack); Items with a model under the namespace 'bracken' get their own tab!

Please note that it only shows items that the client has a recipe for. If you have op, use 
```
recipe give @s *
```
BEFORE opening your inventory. This might not be needed, but I suspect it is needed.
